items.title: Renew Provo business license
items.description: Business licenses renew annually; under city code the renewal application should be submitted at least 90 days before the expiration date, and a late filing does not change the expiration.

note: The renewal date, late penalty and current fee amounts were not confirmed from the city's own pages.

items.title: Obtain and renew a Salt Lake City business license
items.authority: Salt Lake City Finance, Business Licensing
items.description: Anyone who does business within the city limits, permanently or temporarily, and every residential rental property must keep a valid, unexpired business license for each location, renewed each year online. Commercial licenses are reviewed for zoning, building and fire safety, and food businesses also need the Salt Lake Valley Health Department. A business run from home needs no license unless it affects the neighborhood.
items.deadline: Before opening, then renew each year

items.title: Renew West Jordan business license
items.authority: City of West Jordan Business Licensing
items.description: Business licenses renew annually; the city emails the renewal invoice 45 days before the license expires.

note: The renewal date and the late-renewal penalty were not confirmed from the city's own pages.

items.title: Obtain and renew a West Valley City business license
items.description: A business with a place of business in the city limits needs a city business license, which can be renewed online. A home-based business needs a home business license unless it grosses less than $2,000 a year, and the owner of a rental dwelling unit must keep a license current too. Fees are in the city's consolidated fee schedule.
items.deadline: Before opening, then renew each year
